text: I've started my PhD at Harvard University!
Excited to be awarded the GEM Associate Fellowship!
Thrilled to be awarded the NDSEG Fellowship, 3 years of full PhD funding to keep building cool neurotech!
Our new paper, Optimizing Cross-Modal Matching for Multimodal Motor Rehab is a Best Student Paper finalist at ICORR 2025!
Honored to be nominated for the Harvard SEAS Prize Fellowship – 6 years of tuition and 2 years of stipend to support my PhD journey.
Gave a sneak peek of my multimodal-feedback based motor rehabilitation work at BMES 2024 in Baltimore.
Wrapped up an exciting summer at Harvard’s BIONICs Lab, exploring the frontiers – and boundaries – of peripheral neural interfaces in medicine.
I presented my pneumatactor-based soft haptic interfaces at IEEE Haptics Symposium 2024 in sunny Long Beach, CA!
I've started my Master's in Biomedical Engineering at Johns Hopkins University!
